page_title: WER 1-1 DAR | Werder Bremen v Darmstadt 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+8' The goal by Darmstadt is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a handball.
90+8' The Darmstadt players halt their celebrations as referee Florian Badstubner makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
90+7' Goal! Michael Zetterer makes a huge mistake and Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:2.
90+4' Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Darmstadt are awarded a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Sebastian Polter makes his way off the pitch and Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) comes on as his replacement.
89' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
85' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
85' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Darmstadt force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
83' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Werder Bremen win a corner.
80' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Darmstadt players look gutted.
80' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Darmstadt players aren’t happy.
78' The attendance is 40000.
78' Goal! Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.

78' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Michael Zetterer anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
77' Substitution. Jannik Muller (Darmstadt) in, Matej Maglica out.
77' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Senne Lynen and he is replaced by Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
76' It will be a substitution. Dawid Kownacki (Werder Bremen) is ready to enter the pitch as Romano Schmid walks off.
73' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) is penalised for holding. Florian Badstubner signals a set piece.
72' Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
70' Substitution. Julian Justvan did his best and is replaced by Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt).
70' Torsten Lieberknecht decides to make a substitution. Fabian Holland will be replaced by Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt).
70' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) replaces Klaus Gjasula.
67' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matej Maglica (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Florian Badstubner didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' Werder Bremen have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
63' Ole Werner prepares a substitution. Felix Agu is replaced by Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen).
63' The game has come to an end for Justin Njinmah. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Nick Woltemade (Werder Bremen).
62' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Corner kick. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity.
62' A corner kick by Werder Bremen is thwarted by the well prepared Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt).

61' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a sitter. His shot was directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. Werder Bremen earn a corner.

60' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
56' Florian Badstubner shows a yellow card to Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) for his blatant foul.
54' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the left post.
52' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Florian Badstubner had an easy-decision to make.
50' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) receives a pass then lets rip from long range low towards the middle of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
50' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
48' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
48' A player from Werder Bremen takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

47' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) latches onto a brilliant cross and fires the ball towards goal, but his shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
42' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
38' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
35' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
33' 1 - 1 Goal! Matthias Bader passes the ball to Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Michael Zetterer couldn't do anything about it. 1:1.
32' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
32' A player from Werder Bremen commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. Darmstadt will take a free kick.
29' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) swings in a cross from the corner, but Marcel Schuhen reads it well and gathers the ball.

28' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Felix Agu (Werder Bremen). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball goes out of play. Werder Bremen are awarded a corner kick.
27' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
26' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.

24' Fabian Holland (Darmstadt) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
22' Darmstadt take a short corner kick.
22' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Darmstadt have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
20' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
20' The Werder Bremen players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Florian Badstubner. NO PENALTY!
19' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Werder Bremen, he's going to review using VAR.
18' Marcel Schuhen (Darmstadt) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Florian Badstubner signals. The advantage of a penalty kick is given to Werder Bremen.
17' One of the players from Darmstadt times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
15' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

14' Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Darmstadt have been awarded a corner kick.
14' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
11' Darmstadt failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
10' Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Darmstadt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

8' 1 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the middle of his own goal and behind the goalkeeper.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Darmstadt.
6' The ball is cleared after Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
5' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for an infringement.
4' A quickly taken corner by Darmstadt.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Emir Karic (Darmstadt) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

3' A short pass finds Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Darmstadt will have the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner was nominated as the referee for this game.
